title: Jagged, Velvety Russian Vegetables Pilaf
description: A hearty one-pot pilaf dish featuring long-fermentation-dough, biryani masala, and a medley of Russian vegetables.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast, warm water, and 1 teaspoon of sugar to rehydrate the yeast.
Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes, or until it becomes frothy.
Add the flour, biryani masala, salt, and black pepper to the bowl.
Mix the dough until it becomes smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes.
Knead the dough for an additional 5 minutes and let it rest for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and sauté until they are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, or until fragrant.
Add the shredded cabbage, carrots, and zucchini to the pot.
Stir to combine and cook for 5 minutes, or until the vegetables are slightly tender.
Punch down the risen dough and cut it into 1-inch pieces.
Add the dough pieces to the pot and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and stir to coat the dough evenly.
Cover the pot with a lid and cook for 15 minutes, or until the dough is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
